subject.title: embedded_run completes with empty final payload → reply silently dropped (lane goes dark, no auto-heal)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the linked PR's default behavior of reclassifying delivery-requested empty isolated cron completions from ok/no-delivery into cron errors?
rationale: The source-reproducible bug is real, but the candidate fix intentionally changes an observable cron run status for existing operators, so owner acceptance belongs in PR review before this issue can close.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cron errors after proof
options.body: Require redacted real cron proof on the linked PR, then land the error reclassification if the owner agrees silent channel failure is worse than the compatibility change.

options.title: Require a compatibility-preserving shape
options.body: Ask the PR author to preserve current silent-empty semantics by default and expose erroring only through an approved policy or diagnostic path.

options.title: Move the fix to a broader supervisor policy
options.body: Keep the PR paused if maintainers want genuinely empty completions handled by a wider retry or supervisor signal instead of cron finalization.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cron errors after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real cron proof on the linked PR, then land the error reclassification if the owner agrees silent channel failure is worse than the compatibility change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the cron finalization and delivery boundary where the status behavior changes.
